newsitem.title: GERMANY: German new vehicle registrations rise in June.
newsitem.headline: German new vehicle registrations rise in June.

text.p: German vehicle registrations rose nearly nine percent in June over the year-ago month, the Federal Motor Office said on Saturday.
New passenger vehicle registrations last month rose 8.7 percent to 344,194 vehicle. The level was also up 17.6 percent from May, which had reported a decline.
Volkswagen AG remained the top seller in Germany during June despite sales falling by 3,012 vehicles to 62,770 vehicles compared with June 1996.
Industry analysts have said VW's sales have been relatively stable ahead of the launch this fall of the new Golf model, one of the Wolfsburg carmaker's top models.
Rival Opel AG, a unit of U.S. carmaker General Motors Corp, saw sales during June rise almost eight percent to 55,038 vehicles in Germany, the motor office said.
